question: Vedantam Satyanarayana Sarma is associated with which of these dances?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kuchipudi.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vedantam Satyanarayana Sarma** is a renowned artist associated with the classical dance form **Kuchipudi**.
 
• Kuchipudi is a dance-drama performance art that originated in the Indian state of Andhra Pradesh.
 
• This dance form is known for its graceful movements and strong narrative storytelling through dance.
 
• Vedantam Satyanarayana Sarma is celebrated for his contributions to preserving and promoting Kuchipudi dance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kuchipudi** has its roots in the ancient Hindu Sanskrit text of **Natya Shastra**.
 
• The dance form typically involves expressive eye movements, intricate footwork, and dramatic storytelling.
 
• It is performed by both solo dancers and groups, often accompanied by a live orchestra.
 
• Kuchipudi performances usually begin with a prayer or an invocation, followed by a series of dance sequences that depict mythological stories.
